summary: Iteration 20 validates the flipped gating rule: multi-angle try-ons are now ungated on ALL tiers. Free-tier caps that remain are (a) 7 try-ons per rolling 7d and (b) 2 body profiles. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration20_multi_angle_ungated.py pass — POST /api/tryon, /api/tryon/outfit, and /api/tryon/garment with angles=['front','side','back'] as buyer@aurafit.com (Free) return 200 or 502 (never 402/multi_angle). GET /api/subs/me returns gate.multi_angle_allowed=true and gate.premium=false, gate.tryons_limit=7, gate.profiles_limit=2. Weekly-cap enforcement verified by inserting 7 dry tryon rows in the last 7d and confirming next POST /api/tryon returns 402 detail.feature='tryon_weekly_limit'. Profile-cap enforcement verified by seeding 2 body_profiles and confirming POST /api/loved-ones returns 402 detail.feature='profile_limit'. Test-data cleanup fixtures wipe TEST_ inserts on teardown. Frontend (Playwright, 390x844 mobile, buyer@aurafit.com Free): (1) /subscription benefits list = ['Unlimited AI try-ons every week','Up to 10 body profiles for family & clients','Interactive live size slider with fit narration','Early access to new features','Priority Support'] — zero mention of multi-angle. (2) Profile card hint reads exactly 'Unlimited try-ons + up to 10 body profiles · KSh 199/mo'. (3) On item MAISON LUMIÈRE 'Oversized Knit Pullover', tapping [data-testid=item-tryon-multi-btn] fires POST /api/tryon → HTTP 200 (no PaywallModal). Item detail flips to 'TRY AGAIN — FRONT' + share options — confirming hasTryOn was set from the multi-angle result. NOTE: buyer had 7 pre-existing tryons in the 7d window which paywalled the first attempt with title 'You've hit your weekly try-on limit' (feature=tryon_weekly_limit — the CORRECT remaining gate). After clearing that quota via mongo, the 200 path was verified end-to-end.
